title: GLua lint baseline
description: Findings a project has accepted. Written by 'glua lint --suppress-all' and rewritten by '--prune-suppressions'. Counts rather than line numbers, so ordinary edits do not invalidate it.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON schema for this file.

generated.description: When the baseline was last written. For a human reading a diff; never read back.

files.description: Project-relative file path to rule code to the number of findings accepted for it.
